evidence.claim: Current Hugging Face dataset metadata reports license=other.
The dataset README states source repositories were selected from permissively licensed projects.
A historical README revision declared license=mit, but the current card no longer exposes that license.

decision: Do not use this corpus in Terminus calibration until the dataset-level redistribution/training license and per-record provenance obligations are resolved consistently.
reenable_requirements: current dataset-level license is explicit and compatible with intended calibration/training use
source-repository license/provenance fields are retained per record
repository owner approves enabling the source
dataset_registry.json is updated in a reviewed commit
